BottleneckDescription: Unconditional fetchpriority="high" on whale.webp competes with true mobile LCP image (sky-compact.webp)
RootCause: HERO_PRELOADS['/'] lacks media query on whale.webp preload tag
ProposedFix: Scope whale.webp fetchpriority="high" to desktop (min-width: 901px) and load with standard priority on mobile
RiskAssessment: Low - whale is still preloaded and hydrated without visual shift

BottleneckDescription: useWarmSections auto-fires at 1200ms downloading 7 below-the-fold chunks during hero LCP window
RootCause: autoWarmTimer set to aggressive 1200ms before user interaction or idle settlement
ProposedFix: Increase autoWarmTimer to 3500ms and preserve instant warming on user touch/scroll/key interaction
RiskAssessment: Zero - users who scroll warm immediately; inactive users do not waste bandwidth

BottleneckDescription: Over-eager Latin font subset preloading on predominantly Cyrillic editorial hero
ImpactMetrics: Mobile FCP 3.5s / LCP 5.8s; Score 75; 125KB fonts in head
RootCause: resolveHeroFontPreloads includes Latin subset when brand names (Meta/Instagram) exist in text
ProposedFix: Preload only primary Cyrillic subset for decorative heading fonts or prioritize primary language
RiskAssessment: Low - Latin characters fall back to system/swap font cleanly without blocking

BottleneckDescription: Heavy desk and scene image payloads preloaded simultaneously on mobile viewport
ImpactMetrics: Mobile FCP 2.9s / LCP 6.8s; Score 71; 434KB hero images in head
RootCause: desk-v-800 (251KB) and multiple scene objects (laptop 59KB / notebook 124KB) preloaded in head
ProposedFix: Recompress desk-v-800 with sharp effort 6 / Q82 to reduce bytes by 80-100KB
RiskAssessment: Low - visual fidelity identical; significant bandwidth savings

BottleneckDescription: Render blocking CSS across all routes (index.css + hero CSS chunks)
RootCause: CSS link tags in head block first render paint
ProposedFix: Ensure critical above-the-fold CSS is prioritized and non-critical font library styles remain non-blocking
RiskAssessment: Low - verified by hydration and visual regression test suites

BottleneckDescription: Static test harness and edge API fallbacks serving full HTML shells for API routes
ImpactMetrics: Wasted ~150KB per API call in uncompressed test runs
RootCause: Custom test server lacked gzip compression and API mocking
ProposedFix: Add gzip/brotli compression and lightweight JSON mock responses to test harness

BottleneckDescription: Secondary route-specific hero stylesheets in <head> require second TCP round trip on mobile 4G
RootCause: Separate CSS chunks emitted by Vite for hero components
ProposedFix: Consolidate hero CSS files into src/styles/index.css for single-stream CRP
RiskAssessment: Low - verified by full hydration test suite

BottleneckDescription: Framer Motion entrance animations execute upon SSR hydration in settled viewport
RootCause: Motion components animate opacity/scale/translate even when settled=true
ProposedFix: Guard motion animate and transition props with entranceOff check
RiskAssessment: Zero - animations execute on client navigation but bypass settled SSR

BottleneckDescription: Accessibility audit focus traversal triggers eager route chunk preloading
RootCause: RouteIntentPreloader listened to focusin without :focus-visible check
ProposedFix: Guard focusin with :focus-visible and ignore touch pointerover
RiskAssessment: Zero - natural keyboard and mouse navigation remain fast

BottleneckDescription: Below-the-fold stone pedestal preloaded fetchpriority=high on mobile viewports
ImpactMetrics: Competes with true viewport phone shell LCP image
RootCause: generate-pages preloaded pedestal without in-viewport check
ProposedFix: Prioritize phone shell and set loading=lazy on below-fold pedestal

BottleneckDescription: Broad Latin unicode-range triggered unnecessary prata-400-normal-latin.woff2 download
ImpactMetrics: Font download overhead +36KB on Cyrillic landing
ProposedFix: Restrict Latin range to letters U+0041-005A U+0061-007A
RiskAssessment: Zero - punctuation served by Cyrillic subset
